1. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and __at least one flange__ member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, __wherein the composite fabric layer is applied as a patch or patches covering only selected portions of the radius areas__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, __wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied as a wrapped sheet__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, __and wherein the structural adhesive sheet is folded around the filler__.

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix.

5. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein __the layer of structural adhesive extends beyond the radius areas and the at least one layer of composite fabric extends beyond the radius areas__.

6. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other __by intentional wrinkles or deliberate misalignment during layup__.

7. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, __applied as discrete patches on each channel and the base rather than as continuous coverage__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, __wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied as a wrapped sheet__.

12. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __and wherein each patch is positioned to cover only the radius areas and not the web or flanges__.

13. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, __and wherein the wrapped structural adhesive sheet is positioned primarily within the radius filler zone__.

14. (Cancelled)

15. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __C-shaped in cross-section and the base is flat, and wherein the structural adhesive sheet is wrapped around the reinforcing member before placement in the radius filler zone__.

25. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape having a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and a base, the cap and base each including radius areas between the web and the flanges and __the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone__; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the cap and the base, __applied as discrete patches rather than continuous coverage__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and __a layer of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone__.
